findings.body: A hand-built controller under `apps/api/src` can retain `@Controller('people')` and a `PeopleController` registration after the feature files are removed. Neither matches these route patterns or the recognized class names, so the check can report all clear while the endpoint remains registered. This is the route form used by the starter’s controller at `src/forge/templates/starter/libs/projects/server/src/projects.controller.ts:43`.
findings.title: Detect Nest controller prefixes without a leading slash

findings.body: A demo loader can use `await db.person.create(...)`, where `db` is a Prisma client or transaction. The starter itself uses this alias pattern in `src/forge/templates/starter/libs/history/server/src/history.service.ts:13`, but this matcher only accepts `prisma.person` and `tx.person`. After the other references are removed, the check can report all clear while a fresh demo database still loads the feature’s sample rows.
findings.title: Detect sample-data inserts through Prisma client aliases

findings.body: The previous fix handles comment markers and `example:` only on the matched line. A line containing `/api/v1/clients` inside a multiline block comment or inside an example object declared on a preceding line is therefore classified as code. If it is in the jobs module, the check reports jobs as a user and asks the person which feature to change first, even though there is no dependency.
findings.title: Exclude multiline comments and examples from feature users
